Description: A fragmentary Hebrew copy of Ezekiel from Qumran Cave 4, published in DJD XV as 4Q75. It preserves only Ezekiel 24:2-3, the opening of the parable of the cauldron on the day Babylon drew close to Jerusalem. It is a different manuscript from Batch 1's 4QEzeka (4Q73) and from 4QEzekb (4Q74).
Significance: The smallest Qumran Ezekiel manuscript by content. Its two verses date the cauldron parable's wording to the first century BC, but nothing beyond those verses can be claimed from it.
